title: Echoes of Norms: Investigating Counterspeech Bots’ Influence on Bystanders in Online Communities
reasoning: The paper investigates the impact of counterspeech chatbots on bystanders' perceptions of community social norms and ethical values. It specifically evaluates how participants perceive the bot as a 'transmitter of community norms' and a 'representative of ethical values,' and how these bot-generated interventions influence moral stances and social accountability in online hate speech contexts.
